name: unsloth-local-codex
description: Local Codex workflow for Unsloth Helix with durable goals and plans, GitHub context, long-context Mac inference, skills, memory, and governed learning.

interface.shortDescription: Beta local Codex workflow for Unsloth Helix.
interface.longDescription: Adds a reusable local agent workflow for Unsloth Helix: inspect repository evidence, plan changes, execute durable goals, use portable skills and memory, and validate Mac inference changes without embedding credentials.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the active Helix runtime configuration and propose evidence-backed optimizations.
Plan a Mac inference change and keep explicit user settings authoritative.
Audit an MTP or DFlash-family change against measured runtime evidence.
